title: Beach Wedding & Honeymoon
duration: Two nights in a Garden Bungalow for the couple
heading: Say your vows with the tide behind you: a small beach ceremony, arranged around your day.

inclusions.title: Package inclusions
items: Four hours' exclusive use of the beach lawn and garden
Set-menu dinner for 20 guests
Live bamboo rindik music during the ceremony
Floral arch, aisle petals and table flowers
Bridal bouquet and two buttonholes
Sparkling wine toast for all guests
Two nights in a Garden Bungalow, with breakfast
A candlelit dinner for the couple
Service charge and taxes included

title: Slow Stay
duration: 3 days / 2 nights in a Garden Bungalow
heading: Three unhurried days by the sea, with breakfast, transfers and nothing you have to do.

inclusions.title: Package inclusions
items: Two nights in a Garden Bungalow
Return airport transfer
Cold towel and welcome drink on arrival
Two bottles of drinking water daily
Daily breakfast à la carte at Kemuning Kitchen
Bicycles and beach towels to borrow
Wi-Fi throughout the property
Service charge and taxes included

inclusions.title: Bungalow upgrade, per night
items: Loft Bungalow: add IDR 300,000
Beach Bungalow: add IDR 550,000
Courtyard Suite: add IDR 1,400,000
